examples.english: From the teachings and words of these ascetics, that is, the holy elders, let those who love Christ hasten to unite themselves to God according to virtue and undivided love, expecting at all times the departure of their souls from their bodies, as it is written: “It is better for me to be dissolved from this flesh so that I may be with Christ.”
Is it good to repent often?'

examples.english: When he arrived at Skete, he dwelt as a guest in the monastery of Abba Zacharias of good memory, the priest and hegumen of the holy Laura of Abba Macarius and bishop of the city of Sais, who was a holy man with visions.
